title: Appliance Rebates in Barrie 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Barrie appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient replacements, with Barrie Hydro as distributor.
lead: Barrie has 55,315 households and winters averaging -10.1°C in January. Six appliance rebates run from $25 to $200 for replacing an electric appliance.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Barrie
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: In a city with -10.1°C January lows, the washer and dryer run more in winter, and the heat pump dryer pays the most at $200. 58% of Barrie households live in detached houses, where the laundry often sits in a basement or utility room the owner controls.
Barrie Hydro supplies electricity. Barrie postal codes begin with L, which the Energy Affordability Program lists. 32% of households rent, and the page does not say owners only.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Barrie households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.
Buy new, then upload the receipt

Buy a new appliance from any retailer, then upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase. Used and refurbished units do not qualify. Keep the receipt, the model number and the delivery date together. Barrie households who buy during a sale should still confirm the model is on the list at the time they check out.

The page states no limit per household and no end date. That does not mean unlimited funding, and the program can change. If you plan to replace a washer and a dryer, or a fridge and a freezer, get them on the program's lists first and keep every receipt, since each claim is separate and has its own 60-day window.

About 29% of Barrie's 55,315 households live in homes built before 1981. Age of the house tells you little about the age of the fridge, and a working appliance rarely pays back a swap through a $25 to $200 rebate alone. The rebate suits a replacement you already need to make.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Barrie Hydro offer an appliance rebate?
The page does not say owners only. Ask the landlord.
What if my dryer is gas?
The page asks for an existing electric appliance. Ask the program.
How do I find eligible models?
Each appliance has a product list linked from the program page.
